newsitem.title: UK: BFI down four as all but Capers weaken.
newsitem.headline: BFI down four as all but Capers weaken.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down four points on Thursday at 1,285 points and the Baltic Handy Index was down eight to 1,059 points.
Brokers said Caper timecharter rates have hit $20,000 daily with the fixture of Irfon 165,000 dwt to NSS delivery Taranto early July for a trip via Brazil to Japan.
Although Capers continued firmer in the Atlantic, other sizes have continued to weaken.
It is understood that Halla have fixed another 54,000 heavy grain stem from US Gulf to Japan for about June 5/15 at slightly les than $21.30 no combo agreed yesterday.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was unchanged to seven points higher and turnover was four lots.
